hand switches (gesture -> drawing).mapping: switch layer keys driven by a Smart Bone action or keys

alternative limb drawings.mapping: switch layer per limb, keyed per pose

limb configurations.mapping: alternative bone sets per limb (not exercised)

dynamic draw order.mapping: Moho layer reordering is not assumed scriptable: bake order per pose as separate layer stacks or switch layers

elbow/knee fold corrections.mapping: bake key drawings into a switch layer driven by a Smart Bone action

armpit gusset (procedural).mapping: keyed gusset drawings (5 keys) in a switch layer

transitions (anticipation, overshoot).mapping: keyframes on bones; Moho interpolation is not the AutoRig easing

mesh deformation (weights).mapping: per-vertex weights are not assumed to import

artwork selection engine.mapping: AutoRig's selection does not run inside Moho; export decisions as keys

notes: Moho was not run; no Lua API member is used or invented; no exporter in this phase

live.semantic_hand_triggers: hand actions (pointing, shrugging, raised, relaxed) map to switch drawings
live.ik_stability: artistic poses only reshape the intent; the one IK solver clamps unreachable targets
live.channels_independent: body poses never touch facial layers (face rig unchanged)
live.deterministic_selection: hand, alternative and corrective choices are pure functions of the pose
live.safe_fallbacks: REQUIRES_* poses render a labelled fallback, never a forced deformation
